name: Imakoi ~Succubus to Soitogeru Ore!?~
original_name: イマコイ～サキュバスと添い遂げるオレ！？～
source:
My name is Yuuma Shimazaki. 
Apparently I’m descended from a demon-slaying hero who was cursed by the demon’s dying breath. In this time of peace, my bloodline is still cursed. 

For some reason, any woman I touch is overwhelmed with bad feelings. All I want is to find love, but because of the curse I can't even hold hands with a girl. That’s all I pray for… please, let me find someone to hold hands with. She can be cruel, she can be ugly, just end my loneliness. 

I spend my days and nights renting porn videos. The only person I can touch is myself. 

Then, my prayer is answered when an angel suddenly visits me. 

No… not an angel… a sex demon succubus!

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121959.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我叫尤马·希马扎基。
据说，我的祖先是一位斩杀恶魔的英雄，却遭到了恶魔临死前的诅咒。如今已是和平年代，这份诅咒依然流淌在我的血脉里。

不知为何，凡是被我碰到的女人，都会感到强烈的不适。我只是想谈一场恋爱，却因为这道诅咒，连女孩子的手都牵不了。我所祈求的仅此而已…求求你，让我找到一个能牵手的人吧。她可以很刻薄，也可以很丑，只要能结束我的孤独就好。

我每天都靠租借色情录像度日。唯一能触碰的人，只有我自己。

后来，一位天使突然来访，我的祈祷终于得到了回应。

不…那不是天使…而是魅魔！

[编译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121959.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
